summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to furnish a final short form base shelf prospectus filed on SEDAR+ in Canada, enabling future offerings of up to $500,000,000 in Common Shares, Debt Securities, Subscription Receipts, Warrants, or Units over a 25-month period. This is a routine shelf registration, not a specific transaction. The filing provides no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. It is an ordinary capital markets filing to streamline future access to financing, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle or event-driven catalyst is present.
